headline_marked: Meta settlement grants legal pass on [[children's data]] for AI training
headline: Meta settlement grants legal pass on children's data for AI training
summary: States agree not to sue Meta over child data use for training age-assurance models, a controversial move amid a $18B settlement.
details: Meta has agreed to a massive $18 billion settlement with 29 state attorneys general, which includes a provision allowing the company to use children's data for training its age-assurance models.
This legal pass is granted for the limited purpose of developing and testing a model to detect users under 13, a critical step for Meta's child safety efforts.

While the agreement specifies data won't be used for ad targeting or marketing, the states have agreed not to sue Meta under existing child safety laws, including COPPA, over this specific data usage.

This decision raises policy questions, as it allows data retention and use for AI training in a case that centers on child safety. Experts note that while Meta must isolate this data, the FTC's stance on the matter remains unclear.

The settlement requires Meta to develop and test the age-detection model within one year. An independent auditor will monitor compliance, but the long-term implications and enforcement of these data limitations are still being debated.

headline_marked: [[Grand Theft Auto VI]] trailer drops, revealing stunning graphics and gameplay
headline: Grand Theft Auto VI trailer drops, revealing stunning graphics and gameplay
summary: Rockstar Games unveiled a 26-minute extended look at GTA VI, showcasing impressive visuals and cooperative gameplay between protagonists Lucia and Jason. The game is set for release on November 19th.
details: Rockstar Games has finally released an extended 26-minute preview of Grand Theft Auto VI, offering a deep dive into its gameplay and visuals. The footage, captured on PS5, highlights the game's commitment to the series' signature blend of exploration, driving, crime, and cinematic storytelling, all rendered with significantly improved graphics and environmental detail.

The preview emphasized the cooperative dynamic between protagonists Lucia and Jason. Scenes show them working together during high-stakes situations, such as Jason hanging out of a car window while shooting at pursuing police, with Lucia driving.

Gameplay mechanics were further illustrated through a mission where the protagonists are separated. Players can experience Lucia's stealth approach on one floor while Jason engages in cover-based shooting on another, showcasing dynamic combat and evasion scenarios.

Beyond the core narrative and combat, the trailer offered glimpses of various in-game activities. These include a weapon wheel menu, boat driving, basketball, underwater diving, track racing, and parachuting, hinting at the breadth of content available.

This official reveal follows several apparent leaks of game footage, which Rockstar Games described as "heartbreaking." The extended look was made available on Rockstar's YouTube channel and the official GTA VI website.

Grand Theft Auto VI is slated for release on November 19th with a starting price of $79.99. Notably, the game will not be available on physical discs, indicating a digital-only release for its initial launch.
